name: Tentacruel
description: It has 80 tentacles, each with a venomous tip. These tentacles are also extendible, lengthening when Tentacruel attempts to catch prey. Use caution.

moves.name: Poison Sting
moves.description: The user stabs the target with a poisonous stinger. This may also poison the target.

moves.name: Bubble
moves.description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

moves.name: Water Pulse
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a pulsing blast of water. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Hex
moves.description: The user attacks with relentless intensity. This move's power is doubled if the target has a status condition.

moves.name: Poison Jab
moves.description: The target is stabbed with a tentacle, arm, or the like steeped in poison. This may also poison the target.

moves.name: Acid Armor
moves.description: The user alters its cellular structure to liquefy itself, raising its defensive stats.

moves.name: Hydro Pump
moves.description: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.
